# Facilities & Other Resources

<!-- No page limit. Reviewers read this to answer one question: can this
     environment actually deliver this project? Describe capability, not
     square footage. Tie each resource to an Aim wherever you can. -->

## Laboratory

Space, location, and what it is equipped to do for *this* project.

## Clinical

Patient population, recruitment infrastructure, and expected accrual, if
human subjects are involved.

## Computer

Compute and storage available, including institutional HPC allocation.
State what the analyses in the Approach require and confirm it is available.

## Office

Space for the PI and project personnel.

## Other Resources

Cores, shared instrumentation, biobanks, registries, and data-use agreements
already in place.

## Scientific Environment

Institutional commitment, mentoring and collaborator access, and how the
environment contributes to the probability of success. For ESI mechanisms
(R35 MIRA, DP2), be explicit about protected research time and startup
support — reviewers weigh this heavily for early-stage investigators.
